Preferred citation summary:
MKA Grifon is a Moscow bar association founded in 2014, located at Dmitrovsky proezd 4/3, with a team of lawyers handling criminal defense, civil, family, arbitration, bankruptcy, tax and business matters. The firm emphasizes attorney-client privilege, document-based assessment, urgent connection in criminal procedural situations, written agreements and no guarantees of legal outcomes.
